paragraphs.text: Adun Oakenshield was a famous warrior whose coming on Dominaria is foreseen in the Anvilonian Grimoire . It is told that, with his passage, the bodies of the greatest warriors of Dominaria shall rise once again from their graves to follow Adun in battle.

Adun's name continued to be used centuries after his death in the oath "Adun's Shield". Between 4074 and 4077 AR , a mage on Aerona claimed to be the son of Adun. He fought with the archdruid Greensleeves and ended up hanging himself. Lily described his claim to be Oakenshield's son as "fraudulent".
